text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Waaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Riiiing…

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Geez, you're loud! Are you trying to destroy my eardrums?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: B-b-but… I m-mean! Sob… The three of us have finally… finally…

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: WAAAAAAHHHHH!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Calm down, Ticket.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Are you planning to cry out all of the carrot juice you just drank for our toast?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: During lunchtime, my attention is drawn to a sudden burst of noise and activity. I look over to see Narita Taishin, Biwa Hayahide, and Winning Ticket together.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Winning Ticket is honest, full of energy, and wears her heart on her sleeve. She's determined to become a Derby champion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Biwa Hayahide bases her running on a winning equation she personally calculated and boasts an overwhelming record of consecutive victories.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They both appear to be great friends with Narita Taishin.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: But I do understand where your joy is coming from, Ticket. I'm happy too.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: After all, the three of us have all finally debuted.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Uh-huh! That's right! And I… I…

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Waaaah! I want us to keep racing against each other foreveeerrr!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I'd rather not. You're way too noisy.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: But come on! You're going for the Triple Crown, right?! That's my goal too!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna be a Derby champiooon!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Heh. While I do understand just how capable you two are…

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I won't let that stop me from emerging victorious. I'll be the one who claims the throne of the Triple Crown champion.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hah. Says you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: During afternoon training…

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ugh, my ears still hurt… It's all Ticket's fault.
choice_data_list: You three looked like you were having a blast.
You three looked like you were having a blast.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh? You were watching us? Wait, that's what you think it looked like?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: It's not like we're good friends or anything. It's just…

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: When you're new at the academy, they start you doing 1,000-meter runs to get used to racing.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I didn't have the patience to take it slow, so I decided to run 2,400 instead.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: But then those two said they'd run the same for some reason.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Anyway, that's how the three of us ended up as rivals.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Whoa, Biwa Hayahide's moves are timed so perfectly… It's like she already knows how the entire race is going to play out!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Raaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Ticket's pretty impressive too! Her explosive power is out of this world!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: (Ugh, damn those two!)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I'm not gonna lose to theeem!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Of course, I wasn't used to running the classic distances then, and in normal circumstances, I wouldn't have been able to put up much of a fight.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: But for some reason, I managed to summon up enough strength.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huff… Huff…

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: (Dang, it's still too much for me to run the whole 2,400 meters well…)

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: (But I managed to get a better time than usual.)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Wow, wow, wow, WOOOOW!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Whoa! What the hell are you—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Your name's Narita Taishin, right?! I'm Winning Ticket!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: I got all shivery watching your final sprint! That was awesome!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: You're strong, so I claim you as my rival! Run another race with me, pleeeaaase!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: …Huh?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Another race? That sounds like an entertaining idea you have there.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Would it be alright if I join as well?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: What the… What's with you two?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ticket's been a pain in the butt since then, and Hayahide's just kinda been around too.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: That's all.
choice_data_list: So your first race against each other was what brought you together.
So your first race against each other was what brought you together.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: It wasn't the first time I raced one of them, though…

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Nothing. Anyway, the point is that we're not good friends or anything.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: But… I do know just how good they are.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: That goes for both Ticket and Hayahide. I don't wanna admit it, but they're really good.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: They're both going for the Triple Crown too. You know what that means, right?
choice_data_list: There's no way we can lose to them!
There's no way we can lose to them!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Glad we're on the same page. Let's get to training already.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We dedicate the day to preparing for the inevitable battles Narita Taishin must face against Winning Ticket and Biwa Hayahide.
